subject: Donald Trump
note: Every entry links to a published fact-check by a named outlet, and only claims an outlet rated false are listed. Hand-written entries render the claim as reported speech with the fact-checkers' quoted fragments preserved; entries from the Fact Check API carry the claim text as the fact-checker recorded it. Nothing here is a reconstructed quote.

entries.claim: Said there were “no empty seats” in the arena as he spoke.
entries.reality: There plainly were. Reporters in the hall described rows of empty seats, empty upper decks and sparsely filled side sections; one estimate put attendance around 65–70% when he arrived, and NBC News reported people leaving as the speech passed 90 minutes.

source.name: CNN
source.title: Fact check: Trump, RFK Jr. and others make false claims on night 2 of GOP convention

entries.claim: Said prices on “almost every item” are rapidly going down.
entries.reality: Prices were still rising. CPI data showed inflation running about 3.4%, with far more products getting more expensive than cheaper. Since he took office, food prices were up 4.3% and grocery prices 3.4%, both still climbing.

source.name: CNN
source.title: Fact check: Trump makes numerous false claims in Republican convention speech

entries.claim: Claimed he had kept “every single promise” he made on the campaign trail.
entries.reality: Several remain unmet, including ending the war in Ukraine within 24 hours of taking office, quickly taming inflation, and — dating to 2016 — making Mexico pay for a border wall.

source.name: CNN
source.title: Fact check: Trump makes numerous false claims in Republican convention speech

entries.claim: Said Democrats allowed “11,888 murderers” into the country.
entries.reality: The figure counts non-citizens recorded across multiple decades and multiple administrations — including people convicted of homicide after they arrived — not people admitted under the previous administration.
